Callout.Name: Dumping in the Park
Callout.Message: Waste dumped at a trailhead overnight.

Script.Line: Somebody tipped a trailer load at the trailhead in the night.
There is no vehicle and there is nobody here now.
It is the third time this year at the same spot.

Lines.Approach: Somebody tipped a trailer-load at the trailhead and left. No witnesses, no vehicle.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
